policy: Editorial navigation groups based on primary definitions, explicit anchors, parts of speech and documented neighbours. Proximity is not a synonym, root or etymology claim. Previous positions are preserved exactly; additions extend their topic clusters.
notes: Grouping is approximate and can be revised. Polysemous words have one primary map location. All earlier headwords and their coordinates are retained. New editorial words carry topic links only; no inflections have been added. Coordinate depth is a visual treatment, not linguistic distance.
